summary: A pricing grid lit by a soft brand spotlight and a grid of fine lines that only shows inside the light; the light eases toward the pointer.
use: Hero or feature grids where hovering should reveal structure: pricing tables, bento grids, docs landing pages.
spec: `MotionStage` with `loop={1600}`; each cycle moves the light to the next entry of `waypoints`
`@property --spot-x` and `@property --spot-y` are registered percentages, so `transition: --spot-x 520ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` eases them
The pointer sets `--spot-x` and `--spot-y` from `getBoundingClientRect()`; `onpointerleave` hands control back to the autoplay waypoint
One mask: `radial-gradient(circle 8rem at var(--spot-x) var(--spot-y), #000, transparent 72%)` reveals the line grid, `circle 10rem` paints the brand glow
`@media (pointer: coarse)` sets `touch-action: none` so a finger drags the light instead of scrolling the demo
Under reduced motion `class:spot--run={!m.reduced}` removes the transition and the light rests at `50%` / `40%`
